title: A machine-checkable step check. A step passes only when ALL its checks pass.

label.description: shown in the UI checklist, <= 6 words

type.description: Screen-first: prefer screen_contains / screen_absent / metric_* (metrics are parsed from terminal text on screen). file_* and command_* need a known workdir or `tut run` (precision mode).

app.description: screen_*: only match text inside this app's windows, e.g. 'Code', 'Terminal', 'iTerm2'

metric_pattern.description: how to read this metric off the screen: regex with named groups step and value, e.g. 'epoch\s+(?P<step>\d+).*?loss\s+(?P<value>[0-9.eE+-]+)'

command.description: command_exit_ok: the command the learner runs via `tut run`

metric.description: metric_threshold / metric_trend: name from ::metric:: lines, e.g. loss

by_step.description: threshold must hold by this training step

window.description: metric_trend: number of recent steps to evaluate

prompt.description: visual: question for a vision model about a screenshot (use sparingly)
